svg.text: Not every part of the fern is built the same way. This card asks which affine rule actually owns each coarse cell.
Cell color = dominant affine rule. Brighter cells mean cleaner ownership; darker cells are mixed-rule neighborhoods.
stem = mint, bulk frond = green, left leaflet = blue, right leaflet = gold
share of in-bounds hits within that height band
Global share: hits vs dominant cells
Left bar = share of in-bounds orbit hits. Right bar = share of visited cells where that rule wins locally.
• bulk frond rule: 84.9% of hits, 74.8% of dominant cells
• stem rule: only 1.0% of hits, but still owns 0.4% of the visited grid
• left/right leaflet hit imbalance stays small at 0.1% of all in-bounds hits
Mean purity 99.9% · strong-rule cells (≥75% one rule) 99.9% · total in-bounds hits 120000
